# openwebui_function_valves (Resource)

Configures the Valves (settings) of an Open WebUI function.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_function_valves" "example" {
  function_id = openwebui_function.example.id

  valves_json = jsonencode({
    priority = 5
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function_id` (String) Identifier of the function whose valves to configure. Forces replacement.

### Optional

- `valves_json` (String) JSON object of valve values to apply. Keys must match the function's Valves schema. e.g. `jsonencode({ priority = 5 })`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mirrors `function_id`.
- `spec_json` (String) JSON schema of the function's Valves class. Read-only; returned by Open WebUI.
